info.name: List workspaces for the current user

items.docs:
List all workspaces the current user has access to.

Returns workspaces where the user is either the owner or has
explicit permissions.

Args:
    limit: Maximum number of results to return.
    offset: Number of results to skip.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    Paginated list of workspaces.

Create a new workspace (synchronous, DB-direct).

This endpoint:
1. Auto-suffixes the name if it collides with an existing workspace,
   tombstone, repository, or K8s CRD (e.g. ``myws`` -> ``myws-2``).
2. Creates the workspace DB record and provisions runner infrastructure.
3. Returns with status="ready" on success.

Creation is synchronous — no polling required after a 201 response.

params.name: detail
params.description: If true, load SLXs and firing alerts. Default false: fast metadata-only response.

items.docs:
Get a workspace by its short name.

Args:
    workspace_short_name: The workspace short name (e.g., 'pp-04').
    detail: If true, include additional details (SLXs, alerts, spec). Defaults to false.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    The workspace details.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspace not found or user has no access.

Get workspace provisioning progress without requiring a DB workspace record.

Non-detail endpoint — bypasses workspace permission checks.
Only requires authentication. Returns boolean stage flags and sync status.
Used by the UI wizard to poll until all provisioning stages complete.

CRD-less mode: workspace creation is synchronous — all stages are
complete if the workspace exists in the database.

Update a workspace (partial update).

Accepts workspace name (slug) as the path parameter. All body fields are
optional; only non-None values are applied.

Supports updating: alias, description, scrubber_config, enabled_locations,
config_provided, permissions (full replacement), slx_groups, slx_relationships.

Requires admin permission on the workspace.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace short name (slug, e.g. 'my-workspace').
    data: The workspace update data.
    session: Database sess

Delete a workspace with full multi-system cleanup.

Phase 1 (sync): Vault secrets, Slack, K8s CRDs, git repo, DB + tombstone.
Phase 2 (async): Sobow, USearch, GCS files, email notification.

Returns step-by-step status for each cleanup operation.
Requires admin permission on the workspace.

Get the workspace configuration index from sobow.

The configuration index contains cached workspace data including:
- SLX metadata and task information
- Entity index (Kubernetes resources, cloud resources, etc.)
- Workspace relationships and hierarchies

This endpoint proxies to the sobow service which owns the canonical
workspace configuration index cached in Redis.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name (not ID).
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Get workspace metadata from sobow service.

Returns metadata about the workspace including index status,
task counts, and other operational information.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name (not ID).
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.
    sobow: Sobow client for fetching metadata.

Returns:
    The workspace metadata as a dictionary, or None if not available.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspace not found.
    HTTPException: 503 if sobow ser

Get entities (Kubernetes resources, cloud resources, etc.) for a workspace.

Entities are extracted from the workspace configuration and represent
the discoverable resources that can be referenced in tasks.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name (not ID).
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.
    sobow: Sobow client for fetching entities.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing workspace entities organized by type.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspac

Get the health status of the workspace task index.

Returns information about the index's current state, including
last update time, task counts, and any indexing errors.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name (not ID).
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.
    sobow: Sobow client for fetching health status.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing index health information.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspace not found.
    HTTPException: 503 if sobo

Get the status of a workspace creation.

This endpoint is used to poll for workspace creation completion.
It checks:
1. Whether the workspace exists in the database
2. Whether the WorkSync has successfully reconciled

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    WorkspaceStatusResponse with workspace and sync booleans.

info.name: Get current user's permissions on workspace

items.docs:
Get the current user's permissions (roles) on a workspace.

Returns a list of role strings the user has on this workspace.
This matches the Django implementation which returns a set of roles.

info.name: Get workspace sync status from WorkSync CRD

items.docs:
Get the sync status for a workspace from the WorkSync Kubernetes CRD.

Returns information about the workspace's GitOps sync status including
conditions, last applied revision, and related Kubernetes events.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name (not ID).
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing WorkSync status and events.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspace not found or no WorkSync CRD exists.

Get list of secret key names for a workspace.

Returns only the key names, not the secret values.
Requires read access to the workspace.

Create or update workspace secrets in Vault.

Requires admin access to the workspace.

Permanently delete a single workspace secret by key.

Requires admin access to the workspace. Mirrors Django's
``WorkspaceViewSet.delete_workspace_secret``.

info.name: List where a workspace secret is used

items.docs:
Return the SLIs and Runbooks that reference this workspace secret.

Used by the UI to warn before deleting a secret that is still in use.
Requires read access to the workspace. Mirrors Django's
``WorkspaceViewSet.get_secret_usage``.

info.name: Reset or create workspace service account

items.docs:
Reset or create the service account for a workspace.

If a service account exists for this workspace, updates its password.
If no service account exists, creates a new one.

Also writes the credentials to Vault for use by SLI/Runbook containers.

Requires admin access to the workspace.

params.name: token
params.description: Token to trade for SA token

items.docs:
Get the workspace service account token.

Trades an existing valid token for a workspace service account token.
This is used by runners and SLI containers to authenticate with PAPI.

Valid tokenTypes:
- LOCATION_WORKSPACE_SA_TOKEN: Token from location namespace

info.name: Get GitLab service accounts for workspace

items.docs:
Get GitLab service accounts for the workspace repository.

Returns service accounts filtered by the user's access level:
- Admin/readwrite users get both read and write service accounts
- Read-only users get only read service accounts

Returns empty list for non-GitLab (e.g. Gitea) environments.

Search for tasks in a workspace.

Supports scoping to specific SLXs and persona-based query interpretation.
Get autocomplete suggestions for task search.
Returns runners registered for this workspace.
Deprecated: use GET /{workspace_name}/upload-config instead. Returns 410 Gone.

Return search scope options for the workspace.

Returns SLX groups, subgroups, and individual SLXs with firing alert status.
Used by the workspace chat page to build the scope selector.

info.name: Generate upload config for a location

items.docs: Returns an SA-scoped uploadConfig for the given workspace and location. Works for both private and public locations — no runner registration required.

Generate upload credentials for runner-control.

Returns a short-lived SA token and the public PAPI URL so runner-control
can assemble a complete ``uploadInfo`` for workspace-builder.

**Network isolation:** This endpoint MUST be blocked from external access
via an ingress deny rule on ``/*/internal/*`` (same pattern as ``/metrics``).
Runner-control reaches PAPI through the cluster-internal Service URL, which
bypasses ingress. The ``RW-Runner-Token`` header is required as a secondary
guard but i

Get a runner registration token for a workspace.

Requires admin permission on the workspace.
Calls the internal runner service to generate a token.

Args:
    workspace_name: The workspace name.
    location: The location name for the runner.
    session: Database session.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    The runner token response from the runner service.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if workspace not found.
    HTTPException: 403 if user lacks admin permission.
    HTT

Check whether anonymous mode is enabled for a workspace.

Access: Staff or workspace admin.

Enable or disable anonymous mode for a workspace.

Access: Staff or workspace admin.

Get pre-aggregated workspace statistics for the chat page subtitle.

Returns alias, assistantCount, tasksCount24h, resourceTypeCounts, issuesCount24h.

info.name: Get top resources by issue count

items.docs:
Get top resources with most issues in a configurable time window.

Returns resources grouped by SLX hierarchy with issue counts,
for ticker display on the workspace chat page.

info.name: Get AgentFarm parameters for a workspace

params.name: llm_category
params.description: LLM category: DEFAULT, CHAT, BACKGROUND, EMBEDDING

items.docs:
Get parameters for AgentFarm including LLM config, org, user perms, and repo info.

Also serves to authenticate the user/workspace combination for AgentFarm.

Proxy workspace activities from the activities service.

Django parity: WorkspaceViewSet.get_activities proxies to the activities
service via activityutils.fetch_workspace_activities().

Delete a runner from the database.

Validates that the runner belongs to the specified workspace,
deletes the runner record, and revokes associated upload PATs.
Returns the workspace layout JSON (or alt_layout when ?alt_layout=true).

params.name: alt_layout
params.description: Save to alt_layout instead of layout

items.docs: Saves an arbitrary JSON body as the workspace layout (or alt_layout when ?alt_layout=true).

Re-run workspace-level runner infrastructure provisioning.

Creates or re-creates the Vault AppRole and cert-manager Certificates for
a workspace. Idempotent — safe to call on already-provisioned workspaces.
Returns per-subsystem status regardless of partial failure (HTTP 200).

Access: Staff only.

Upload a workspace archive for async processing.

Accepts a base64-encoded tar archive containing workspace configuration.
The upload is processed asynchronously via TaskIQ.

Args:
    workspace_short_name: The workspace identifier.
    data: The upload request containing file_content and optional file_hash.
    current_user: The authenticated user.
    session: The database session.

Returns:
    WorkspaceUploadResponse with task_id for status tracking.

Check the status of an upload task.

Args:
    task_id: The task ID returned from the upload endpoint.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    UploadStatusResponse with current task status.

Upload a workspace archive for async processing.

Accepts a base64-encoded tar archive containing workspace configuration.
The upload is processed asynchronously via TaskIQ.

Args:
    workspace_short_name: The workspace identifier.
    data: The upload request containing file_content and optional file_hash.
    current_user: The authenticated user.
    session: The database session.

Returns:
    WorkspaceUploadResponse with task_id for status tracking.

Check the status of an upload task.

Args:
    task_id: The task ID returned from the upload endpoint.
    current_user: The authenticated user.

Returns:
    UploadStatusResponse with current task status.
